Heat generation within a solid (like a b: The heating component within a battery or CPU can increase the temperature of the surrounding material and system. The increase in temperatures due to heat generation can cause a shorten lifespan of nearby components as well as reduce the efficency of other components as they operate under elevated temperature conditions. Therefore, if heat is not properly dissipated and removed from the system, the system can have unexpected system failures due to overheat.
Identify a boundary condition in a commo: A common household appliance would be an electric kettle. The outer surface is a convection boundary layer to the ambient air along with a conduction boundary layer between the ambient air and the water inside the kettle. If the kettle was used underwater the convection heat transfer coefficent would be much higher compared to ambient air resulting in a greater heat transfer. Furthermore, if the kettle was placed into space the convection boundary layer would no longer exist since space acts as a vaccuum. Instead the convection boundary layer would be replaced with thermal radiation.
